name: Bases View Tabs
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds visible Base view tabs with keyboard navigation.
Frees wrapping, and optional Pro pins and icons.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Run Focus the view tabs, then use the arrow keys, Home and End to move between the views of a Base.
Turn on Wrap tabs in Settings to show long view names on more than one line instead of scrolling.
tip: Assign a hotkey to Focus the view tabs in the Hotkeys settings. Then press it and use the arrow keys to pick a view.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases View Tabs is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your Bases.
